name: Young jackfruit salad
summary: Young jackfruit, boiled and mixed. Người Lao Động uses boiled pork, shrimp, or chicken. Báo Quốc tế says pork and shrimp. Ripe jackfruit eaten from the trees at Trung An is a different plate.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động says jackfruit orchards here fruit through the year, and that this salad is eaten most in this district among southern versions.
howToEat: Người Lao Động: fruit whose segments have started and whose seeds have not formed. Drain the sap, peel, keep the flesh and the fiber, boil large pieces with a little salt, repeatedly, so the tannin is gone and the flesh does not blacken. Tear it and mix with boiled pork, shrimp, or chicken. Sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, cilantro, and sesame. Eat with rice, or as a plate with drinks.
Báo Quốc tế: young jackfruit mixed with pork and shrimp. Eat with rice, or as a plate with drinks. Chicken is not in that account.
